Dear

I would like to raise a formal complaint regarding my recent experience at Cinepolis, Oman Avenues Mall.

Yesterday, I visited your theatre to watch a Malayalam movie Aadu 3
Screen 2 , but unfortunately, it turned out to be one of the worst experiences I have ever had in a cinema. The audio quality was extremely poor — the sound was almost inaudible throughout the movie. As a cinema lover, this was very disappointing. It is not just about the money I spent, but also about losing the opportunity to properly enjoy a film I was looking forward to. I also noticed that several other customers had raised complaints at the theatre itself, yet no effective action was taken to resolve the issue.

I work hard to earn my money, and I expect a basic level of quality and service when I pay for a movie ticket. Unfortunately, that expectation was not met.

I kindly request you to take this matter seriously, investigate the issue, and ensure such incidents do not happen again. I would also appreciate appropriate compensation or resolution for this inconvenience.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Cinépolis at Oman Avenues Mall offers a decent movie experience, but there are areas that need improvement. Parking on the rooftop is the best option since it provides direct access to the cinema, which is quite convenient.

However, I found the display quality disappointing—it leans towards the darker side, making it difficult to fully enjoy the visual effects. The sound system is average and doesn’t provide the immersive experience expected from a premium theater.

I watched Empuraan (Malayalam movie) on Screen 6, and the experience was just okay. Food items and bags are not allowed inside, which can be inconvenient.

The deluxe seating is quite hard, lacking proper cushioning, making it uncomfortable for longer movies. The temperature is set to a normal level, which might be a plus for some, but I personally expected a more chilled environment.

The food section has multiple counters, but during the interval, long queues form, and staff seem insufficient to handle the rush. That said, the staff is very attentive and professional, ensuring smooth service despite the crowd.

Overall, Cinépolis Oman Avenues Mall is average—convenient parking and good staff, but the display, sound quality, and seating comfort could be significantly improved. Would consider visiting again if these issues are addressed.

సోహార్‌లోని ఓయాసిస్ మాల్‌లో ఉన్న సినీ పోలీస్ మూవీ థియేటర్‌ను సందర్శించిన అనుభవం నిజంగా అద్భుతమైనది. ఈ థియేటర్‌లో సినిమా చూసే ప్రతి క్షణం అసాధారణమైన అనుభూతిని అందిస్తుంది. థియేటర్‌లోని సౌండ్ సిస్టమ్ అత్యుత్తమ నాణ్యతతో, సినిమా అనుభవాన్ని మరింత ఆకర్షణీయంగా మార్చింది. స్క్రీన్‌ల నాణ్యత, శుభ్రత, మరియు వాతావరణం అన్నీ అత్యంత ఆకర్షణీయంగా ఉన్నాయి.

ముఖ్యంగా, సిబ్బంది ప్రవర్తన చాలా సహకార ధోరణితో మరియు స్నేహపూర్వకంగా ఉంది, ఇది సందర్శకులకు సౌకర్యవంతమైన అనుభవాన్ని అందిస్తుంది. టికెట్ బుకింగ్ కోసం అందుబాటులో ఉన్న టచ్ స్క్రీన్ మానిటర్‌లు స్వయం సేవను సులభతరం చేస్తాయి, ఇది సమయాన్ని ఆదా చేస్తుంది. ఈ థియేటర్‌లో మొత్తం ఎనిమిది స్క్రీన్‌లు ఉన్నాయి, ఇందులో భారతదేశంలోని వివిధ రీజనల్ భాషల సినిమాలతో పాటు హాలీవుడ్ చిత్రాలు కూడా ప్రదర్శితమవుతాయి, ఇది విభిన్న రుచులను ఆకర్షిస్తుంది.

ఓయాసిస్ మాల్‌లో షాపింగ్ అనుభవం కూడా అద్భుతంగా ఉంది. ఫుట్‌వేర్, దుస్తులు, పుస్తకాలు, కాస్మెటిక్స్, బేకరీ ఐటమ్స్, ఫుడ్ కోర్ట్‌లు ఇలా అన్ని రకాల షాపింగ్ సౌకర్యాలు ఒకే చోట అందుబాటులో ఉన్నాయి. మొత్తంగా, సినీ పోలీస్ థియేటర్ మరియు ఓయాసిస్ మాల్ సందర్శన సినిమా ప్రియులకు మరియు షాపింగ్ ఔత్సాహికులకు ఒక అసాధారణ అనుభవాన్ని అందిస్తుంది.

This review is pertaining specifically to the Junior Theatre in Cinepolis at Avenues Mall. This is a unique experience as a mini play area is created right inside the theatre. There is a long slide which ends in a ball pit. There is a section for toddlers as well.
The seating area has been well designed for kids and adults to enjoy. The bean bag seats are a lot more comfortable than the non-reclining seats in other theatres. Of course, there is bound to be squeaks and cries of the kids since it is designed for them but for those families going with small kids, it should definitely be the first choice.
The screen and audio system cannot be called the best as there are better options available but then with the kids around, one will barely notice that.

text:
Having an alternative option for a cinema experience is always welcomed!

Recently, I tried the luxury venue of another competitor's cinema, and to say the least, it was not as comfortable, or grand as I expected.

This place revived my faith in paying a premium for a luxury experience, and actually getting a luxury experience. The seats are relaxing to sit on, considering yet again the movie we watched was exactly 3 hours long. The leg rests could use a bit more cushioning, but the lumbar support is so much better than the competition.

Picture and sound quality is great too. However, I don't know if it's my bad luck again at play, but we had the fire alarm blip light up during the movie, and then randomly turn off after a short while.

Food is great, but the popcorn could certainly be better. I unfortunately could not take photos of the dishes we had cause of the lighting situation during the movie, but I HIGHLY recommend you order their free-range chicken burger, popcorn chicken with honey mustard, and the nachos with cheese.

Price?

I would probably recommend to try the luxury plaza once, or keep it for big blockbuster movies, but generally speaking, I would opt for the regular plazas, which from other reviews, and photos, actually looks very decent as well.
